introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees bent and your arms stretched forward. 

Then lift your upper body off the floor. Hold for a few seconds and slowly return. 

It primarily works the rectus abdominis muscle and the obliques.
name: ABDOMINAL CRUNCHES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Use your abdominal strength.
You will get better results if you do it slowly.
Relax your neck.
Always keep your lower back on the floor.
It's not right to use your arms to propel your body upwards.
To fully engage your abs, please don't use explosive strength.
Exhale when raising, and inhale when lowering.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
You should feel your abdominal muscles burning.
You shouldn't feel your neck is sore.
It's a good workout for your abs.

introduce: Sit on the floor with your knees bent, feet lifted a little bit and back tilted backwards.\n\nThen hold your hands together and twist from side to side.
name: RUSSIAN TWIST

tips.text: We suggest that you do this on a mat.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Keep your legs still.
Tighten your abs.
Don't move your legs when twisting.
Breathe naturally.
To get more of a challenge, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
If you feel it's too hard, put your feet on the floor.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
This primarily targets your obliques.

introduce: Start in the push-up position. Bend your right knee towards your chest and keep your left leg straight, then quickly switch from one leg to the other. \n\nThis exercise strengthens multiple muscle groups.
name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBER

tips.text: We suggest you do this on a mat.
Bring your knees as close to your chest as possible.
Don't lift your hips up.
Take steady and deep breaths.
If you feel it's too easy, do it as fast as you can.
If you feel it's too hard, adjust to a speed that makes you feel comfortable.
If you feel it's too hard, elevate your hands on a bench.
This is a great full body exercise.
This can strengthen your cardiovascular system.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, then put your hands on the ground and kick your feet backward. Do a quick push-up and then jump up.
name: BURPEES

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your core tight.
Put your hands between your knees.
Bend your legs to get your hands on the floor instead of bending your body.
Don't make your elbows point outward when doing the push-up.
You shouldn't feel strain in your back and shoulders.
Do the steps of the exercise as quickly as you can.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.

introduce: Start in the squat position, then jump up using your abdominal muscles for strength. This exercise works your abdomen.
name: JUMPING SQUATS

tips.text: Remember to use the strength of your abs.
Keep your knees extended in the same direction as your toes.
When squatting down, your chest should be higher than your hips.
Absorb the shock with your muscles when landing.
When you squat down, your knees shouldn't go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, put your hands behind your head.
To get more of a challenge, bring your feet together when jumping up.
Too easy? Raise your knees as high as you can when jumping up.
If you feel it's too hard, use your arms to help propel your body up.
It's a good exercise for your legs and gluteus.

introduce: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your hands underneath your hips.\n\nSlightly lift your legs and shoulders, and then alternately cross your legs over one another.
name: CRISSCROSS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your abs tight.
Please keep your feet off the ground.
Don’t forget to breathe.
Try to keep your legs as straight as you can.
It’s a good exercise for your abs and thighs.

introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the ground. \n\nRaise your legs to the tabletop position; drop your left foot towards the ground. Tap the ground with your toes; then raise the leg back. Switch sides, and repeat the exercise.
name: TOE TAP

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your knee steady as you drop your leg towards the ground.
Exhale as you drop your leg; inhale as you bring it back.

introduce: Start in a straight-arm plank position. Put your hands directly under your shoulders, and keep your feet shoulder-width apart. Keep your body straight. \n\nPush your hips up and back into an upside-down \"V\" shape. Return to the starting position, and repeat.
name: STRAIGHT ARM PLANK TO PIKE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Your head should be in line with your arms when lifting your hips.
Keep your core tight to maintain stability throughout the exercise.
This is an effective exercise to develop core stability and strength.

introduce:
Lie on a mat with your arms extended by your sides and your legs extended straight up toward the ceiling.

Draw your navel in toward your spine. Slowly lower your legs to one side.

Engage your core and lift your legs back up, rotating them in an arc to the opposite side and back down to the starting position.

Repeat on the other side.
name: CORKSCREW

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and down on the mat.
Please inhale as you prepare and exhale as you twist or rotate your legs.
Breathe consistently and avoid holding your breath.
This exercise helps strengthen and stabilize the core.

introduce:
Lie flat on a mat, extend your legs at an angle from the mat. Engage your core, lift your shoulders off the mat with arms straight by your ears, shoulder-width apart. Inhale to prepare.

Exhale, bend your knees towards your chest as you sweep your arms out to the sides, reaching around to grasp your shins or ankles and squeeze.

Inhale, reach your arms over your head and keep your legs long.

Repeat the exercise.
name: DOUBLE LEG STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your shoulders lifted.
Please keep your core engaged.
This exercise can stabilize your core muscles.
This exercise helps with your abdominal strength.

introduce:
Lie flat on your back, and bend your knees into the chest. Place your hands behind your head to support your head with your fingertips.

Lift your head, neck, and shoulders off the mat, engaging your abdominal muscles.

Extend your right leg out straight into the air while simultaneously rotating your upper body to bring your right elbow towards your left bent knee. 

Switch your legs as you bring your left elbow toward your right knee. 

Repeat the exercise.
name: PILATES CRISS CROSS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please do not strain your neck and head.
Please keep your core tight.
Please do not hold your breath.
Please keep the elbows wide.
Please make sure your pelvis is stable.
This exercise helps you build strong obliques and a more defined waistline.

introduce:
Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms resting by your sides.

Extend your legs toward the ceiling. Engage your core muscles to lift your shoulders off the mat. Hold your right ankle with both hands. Lower your left leg at an angle.

Pull your right leg once. Switch legs and repeat the exercise.
name: SINGLE STRAIGHT LEG STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your pelvis and trunk stable.
Please keep your legs straight.
You can adjust the angle of your leg and the position of your hands on your leg.
This exercise challenges the abdominal muscles.
This exercise can stretch the hamstring muscles of the back of the thighs.
